descriptions.trips: Excursions, camps and discoveries: program, documents and online registration.

searchPlaceholder: Search a trip or a destination…

empty.hint: The next adventures are coming soon!

detail.deleteText: Registrations will be deleted and unpaid invoices cancelled. Not possible once payments were received.
detail.noProgram: The detailed program will be published soon.

form.programHint: One step per line: "08:00 | Departure" or "Day 1 | Settling in".
form.priceHint: 0 = free. An invoice is created for each registration.
form.monitorsHint: Choose the managers: they handle the participant list and payments, take the roll-call and send the report to the accountant.

kid.title: An adventure awaits!
kid.text: Show this trip to your parents: they can sign you up from their account.

flow.title: Trip registration
flow.chooseChild: Which child would you like to register?

reasonHint.closed: Registration isn't open for this trip.
reasonHint.deadline: The deadline has passed. Contact the team if needed.
reasonHint.tooYoung: This trip is for older children. Other adventures are coming soon!
reasonHint.tooOld: This trip is for younger children.

flow.fullHint: The trip is full: the registration will go on the waitlist.
flow.consentText: I allow {name} to take part in the "{title}" trip, group transport and planned activities, under the responsibility of ONET monitors. In an emergency, I allow the team to take the necessary measures.
flow.waitlistText: As soon as a place frees up, the registration moves forward automatically and you get notified.
flow.payText: The place is reserved. Pay the invoice online to confirm the registration.
flow.awaitingText: The team will confirm the registration very soon.
flow.confirmedTitle: It's confirmed: {name} is coming with us!

cancel.title: Cancel the registration?
cancel.text: The place will be freed and the unpaid invoice cancelled.
cancel.paidText: The place will be freed. The payment already made will be handled by the accounts team for a refund.

managers.title: Trip managers
managers.hint: Managers build the participant list, collect payments and send the report to the accountant.
managers.removeText: This person will no longer manage the trip's list and payments.

manage.waitlist: {count, plural, =0 {} one {# on the waitlist} other {# on the waitlist}}
manage.emptyHint: Add the kids and members who are going, then collect their payments.
manage.showCancelled: {count, plural, one {# cancelled registration} other {# cancelled registrations}}
manage.addHint: A kid or member already known, or a new person.
manage.noCandidates: Nobody found. Add them as a new person.
manage.parentHint: A contact card is created for the parent (no account); a known number is reused.
manage.newHint: The person is saved as one of the association's kids, then registered to the trip.
manage.addedWaitlist: Trip full: participant put on the waitlist
manage.removeText: The registration is cancelled. An unpaid invoice is cancelled; money already received will be refunded by the accountant.
manage.finalize: Finalize and send to the accountant
manage.finalizeText: The list will be frozen and the accountant automatically receives the detailed report ({count} participants, {collected} collected).
manage.finalizeUnpaid: Warning: {count, plural, one {# participant hasn't paid in full} other {# participants haven't paid in full}} ({amount} outstanding).
manage.finalized: List finalized: the accountant received the report
manage.lockedText: The list is frozen: no more additions or removals. Payments can still be recorded.
manage.reopenText: Managers will be able to edit the list again, then finalize it.

notify.finalizedBody: {count, plural, one {# participant} other {# participants}} · collected {collected} · outstanding {outstanding} — by {name}
notify.managerAssignedBody: Build the participant list, collect payments, then send the report to the accountant.

errors.listClosed: This trip's list is finalized: an administrator must reopen it to edit it.
errors.notParticipant: This person isn't on the list.
errors.noInvoice: Nothing to collect: this registration has no invoice (free trip).
errors.memberType: Only kids and members can be added to the list.
errors.memberInactive: This person isn't active (pending, inactive or suspended): they can't be added to the list.
